Problem Statement:
Your task is simple You are given N strings each of length at most M. You will be given Q queries In each query you will be given a string of length at most M Your task is to find out the number of occurrences in the given list of N strings.
input_spec:
The first line contains two space separated integers N Q-denoting the number of string and the number of queries.
The next N line contains a string each
The next Q lines contains a string each
output_spec: For each query print the number of occurrences of that string in a single line I that string does not occur in the given list at all print a “0” (without quotes)
